title: Technical English — Course 4, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 15

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the documentation review take place?
tasks.audioText: The electrical documentation review will take place on Friday at twelve in the project room. Students should bring the circuit diagram, component list and latest revision record. The instructor will ask each group to check that the references match across the documents. Any unclear item should be listed for confirmation rather than corrected without approval.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which record should students bring?
tasks.audioText: The electrical documentation review will take place on Friday at twelve in the project room. Students should bring the circuit diagram, component list and latest revision record. The instructor will ask each group to check that the references match across the documents. Any unclear item should be listed for confirmation rather than corrected without approval.

tasks.prompt: A project folder contained a circuit diagram, a component list and an inspection record. During review, a student noticed that one component reference was different in the diagram and the list. The student recorded the mismatch and informed the project tutor. The documents were checked against the approved revision before the list was updated. This maintained a clear record of the change. Reading 1. What mismatch did the student notice?
options: A drawing revision differed between two documents
The supplier address differed from the invoice
A component reference differed between the diagram and list
The inspection date differed from the work order

tasks.prompt: What was checked before the list was updated?
options: The equipment serial number was checked against the supplier list
The operator's shift record was checked before the list was updated
The component colour was compared with the parts catalogue
The documents were checked against the approved revision

tasks.prompt: The component list ___ against the approved revision before it is updated.
Choose TWO documents that describe an electrical design and its selected components.
A controlled record showing the current version of a document is a revision ___.
You notice different component references in two documents. What should you do?
options: Change one reference without telling anyone.
Record the mismatch and ask for confirmation against the approved revision.
Copy a reference from an unrelated project.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of electrical documentation review in a logical order.
options: Confirm the approved revision before updating a document
correctOrder: Confirm the approved revision before updating a document

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining why circuit diagrams, component lists and revision records should be checked together during a project review.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: circuit diagrams, component lists and revision records are all addressed (0–2); the response explains why they should be cross-checked for consistency and current status during a project review (0–2); the explanation is clearly organised with understandable grammar (0–2); circuit/document-control vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are accurate (0–2).
